title: Teal Mage Pose Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with short teal hair performing a magical attack, shown from left to right. The character wears a purple and teal wizard outfit with star motifs, a flowing cape, and boots, casting bright cyan magical energy from her hands that intensifies across the panels.
prompt: A female mage with short spiky teal hair and purple eyes, wearing a dark purple and teal wizard robe with star patterns, black cape, and matching boots, shown in four progressive action poses from left to right. She starts with one leg raised holding a swirling orb of cyan magic, then kicks forward releasing energy, then thrusts both hands forward with a bright magical burst, and finally stands in a wide stance with dual swirling magic circles. Dynamic fantasy character art, clean studio lighting, gray background
